## demo_database.items
# `items`
Order line items. One row per unit sold (no quantity column): units = row count. Join to orders for dates/stores and to products for name, type and price. For any sales-by-product, product-mix or category-share question, use the line_sales measure here. Do NOT use products.price:sum from this model: it sums each distinct product's price once, not once per item sold.
Columns: id, order_id, sku, unit_price
Measures: units_sold, line_sales
Aggregations: _(none)_
Joins to: orders, products

SQL:
WITH _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    items.order_id AS "items.order_id"
  FROM items AS items
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON items.order_id = orders.id
  WHERE
    (
      orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    )
  GROUP BY
    items.order_id
), _cm_items__is_bev_sum AS (
  SELECT
    items.order_id AS "items.order_id",
    SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN products.type = 'beverage' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) AS "items.bev"
  FROM items AS items
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON items.order_id = orders.id
  LEFT JOIN products AS products
    ON items.sku = products.sku
  WHERE
    (
      orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    )
  GROUP BY
    items.order_id
), _cm_items__is_jaf_sum AS (
  SELECT
    items.order_id AS "items.order_id",
    SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN products.type = 'jaffle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) AS "items.jaf"
  FROM items AS items
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON items.order_id = orders.id
  LEFT JOIN products AS products
    ON items.sku = products.sku
  WHERE
    (
      orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    )
  GROUP BY
    items.order_id
), __slayer_stage_per_order AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."items.order_id" AS "order_id",
    _stage_inner."items.bev" AS "bev",
    _stage_inner."items.jaf" AS "jaf"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."items.order_id",
      _cm_items__is_bev_sum."items.bev",
      _cm_items__is_jaf_sum."items.jaf"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_items__is_bev_sum
      ON _base_2."items.order_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_items__is_bev_sum."items.order_id"
    LEFT JOIN _cm_items__is_jaf_sum
      ON _base_2."items.order_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_items__is_jaf_sum."items.order_id"
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN per_order.bev > 0 AND per_order.jaf > 0
    THEN 'both'
    WHEN per_order.bev > 0
    THEN 'beverages only'
    WHEN per_order.jaf > 0
    THEN 'jaffles only'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS "per_order.mix",
  COUNT(*) AS "per_order.orders"
FROM __slayer_stage_per_order AS per_order
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN per_order.bev > 0 AND per_order.jaf > 0
    THEN 'both'
    WHEN per_order.bev > 0
    THEN 'beverages only'
    WHEN per_order.jaf > 0
    THEN 'jaffles only'
    ELSE 'other'
  END
LIMIT 21
